Developed for those who dream of running their own pizzeria, [i]Pizza Shop Simulator[/i] is now available!
Knead the dough, choose your sauces, fire up the oven, and build your pizza empire from the ground up![/p][p]🚀 [b]What Awaits You?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Realistic cooking and order management systems[/p][/*][*][p]Progress based on customer satisfaction[/p][/*][*][p]The opportunity to grow and customize your very own restaurant[/p][/*][/list][p]🖥️ [b]Double the Fun with Mini Computer Games![/b] 🎮
[i]Pizza Shop Simulator[/i] isn’t just about cooking!
In the back room of your shop lies an old-school computer filled with retro-style mini games to enjoy during your breaks.[/p][p]🎮 [b]What Do Mini Games Offer?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bonus rewards and special items as you rack up high scores[/p][/*][*][p]Clues that unravel the mysterious stories within your pizzeria[/p][/*][/list][p]👽 [b]Co-Op Alien Hunt Mode – Fight the Unexpected![/b]
When night falls, things get weird...
Team up with your friends in a thrilling co-op mode where mysterious alien forces threaten your shop.
Grab your tools, stick together, and survive the invasion![/p][list][*][p]Up to 16-player online co-op[/p][/*][*][p]Waves of alien enemies and eerie nighttime missions[/p][/*][*][p]Combine teamwork and strategy to protect your pizzeria[/p][/*][/list][p]❤️ [b]A Huge Thank You to All of You![/b]
From the very beginning of [i]Pizza Shop Simulator[/i] to today, we’ve been truly grateful to every single one of you who supported us — through your ideas, testing, feedback, and contagious excitement.[/p][p]This journey became more meaningful and powerful thanks to your support.
Every message, every comment, and every bit of anticipation has kept us inspired.[/p][p]🍕 We built this game together — and now it’s finally time to enjoy it, together![/p]

notes.title: NEXT FEST Steam Pizza Shop Simulator Gameplay
DEMO RELEASED
notes.content:
James is no ordinary pizza deliveryman, but a trustworthy but introverted man who makes deliveries in his boss's 1965 red Mustang. It's not his car - the owner of the pizzeria is a grumpy but wealthy ex-street racer, who delivers it only because he trusts James. But that night... everything changes.

As raindrops hit the shiny hood of the Mustang, James sets off for the last delivery of the night. The address is on an unknown street, not even marked on a map. As the Mustang's powerful engine rips through the silence of the deserted roads, James feels an inexplicable restlessness.

The eyes of the old man who opens the door are full of fear. Just as he is about to deliver the pizza, a faint, suppressed scream comes from inside. James hesitates. This is not his car; to risk it would cost him his boss, his job, perhaps his life. But with a momentary spark of conscience, he goes inside... and nothing is the same after that moment.

The secrets inside the house draw James into the middle of a chain of crimes. The Mustang is no longer just a car, but a witness to escapes, chases, and moments of life and death. And his boss may be playing a much deeper role in all of this than previously thought.
